title: UI agent status: measuring every worker

slides.title: Some workers still cannot report live generation
slides.say: The worker list and brain counters are built. Codex's running server and JARVIS's own streamed workers expose activity. Claude's native subagents do not send token events to their parent. Existing Claude terminals do not provide that stream either. Counting those as generating would give you the same misleading status you asked us to remove.

blocks.lead: A running session is not always generating tokens.

slides.title: The count fits the existing brain display
slides.say: This is the implemented display, using demonstration data rather than your live counts. The previously empty circle holds each provider's count. The question mark stays visible when a worker has no generation stream. Opening the circle shows every worker under its project and parent, with tools and queues distinguished from generation. This has not been deployed to your running app.

blocks.alt: Production brain account components with worker counters
blocks.caption: Illustrative data: two observed OpenAI workers; Claude generation unmeasured.

slides.title: Each worker needs its own observable session
slides.say: To finish the count, JARVIS needs to host each Claude worker separately and receive that worker's stream directly. That replaces the way native Claude subagents are launched; they remain children on the board. Existing named terminal workers would move only when idle, carrying their conversation forward. Approval handling, cancellation and messages must keep working before any handover. Your active sessions have not been changed.

points.text: Each child gets its own measured stream.
Hand over at idle; one writer per session.

decisions.question: Should JARVIS host the workers so every worker can report generation?
decisions.context: The complete count requires changing how Claude terminal workers and native subagents execute.
decisions.say: I recommend hosting the workers. That lets each one report its own generation instead of guessing from a running label. The alternative keeps native terminal and subagent execution, but those workers must stay visibly unmeasured. Choosing hosting continues this build; it does not interrupt your current sessions immediately.

options.name: Host each worker
options.says: Continue the build with separate streamed sessions and an idle-boundary handover.

options.name: Keep native execution
options.says: Keep native terminals and subagents; their generation stays visibly unmeasured.

decisions.reason: A separate stream for every worker is the supported way to measure every worker without guessing.
